column3: n. 嗡嗡作声的东西, 蜂音器;蜂鸣器; 磨轮; 砂轮
column5: The quiz contestant hit the buzzer a second before her rival.
column6: 智力竞赛选手比对手早一秒按下了抢答器。

column6: 园丁每年春天把名贵苹果树的枝条嫁接到更强健的砧木上。

column3: a. 狂热的, 盲信的
column5: He was so fanatical about punctuality that he arrived an hour early everywhere.
column6: 他对守时近乎狂热,到哪儿都提前一小时。

column3: n. 周围环境, 气氛

column6: 柔和的灯光和轻缓的爵士乐让这家小咖啡馆氛围轻松。

column3: a. 可理解的
column5: The coach's clear diagrams made the complex play comprehensible to every rookie.
column6: 教练清晰的示意图让复杂战术在每个新人看来都易懂。

column3: vt. 校对, 校勘;整理
column5: Volunteers helped collate the survey responses before the analysts began their work.
column6: 志愿者帮助整理问卷答案,分析员随后开始工作。

column3: a. 奢侈的, 华丽的
column5: The wedding banquet featured a sumptuous spread of seafood and regional delicacies.
column6: 婚宴摆上了丰盛的海鲜和地方美食。

column3: a. 有害的, 有毒的, 使道德败坏的;有害的, 有毒的
column5: Firefighters wore masks to protect against noxious fumes inside the burning warehouse.
column6: 消防员戴上防毒面具,以免吸入燃烧仓库里的有毒烟气。

column3: a. 朝生暮死的, 短命的, 短暂的;暂时的
column5: Cherry blossoms are ephemeral, which is exactly why crowds cherish them each spring.
column6: 樱花转瞬即逝,这也正是人们每年春天格外珍惜的原因。

column3: a. 不足以令人相信的
column5: The defendant's unconvincing account of that night weakened his case considerably.
column6: 被告对当晚难以自圆其说的陈述大大削弱了他的辩护。

column3: n. 厌恶, 反感;反感, 厌恶; 相克疗法
column5: Her antipathy toward spreadsheets made budget season the worst part of her job.
column6: 她对电子表格的反感让预算季成了她工作中最难熬的时光。

column3: a. 珠状的；饰以珠的
column5: The museum displays a beaded ceremonial dress that took four years to complete.
column6: 博物馆展出一件耗时四年完成的珠饰礼服。

column3: n. 大厦, 大建筑物
column5: The steel and glass edifice towers over the old market quarter.
column6: 这座钢铁玻璃大厦高耸于老集市街区之上。

column3: a. 可争论的, 成问题的, 未决定的
column5: Whether the tax reform helped small businesses remains hotly debatable among economists.
column6: 税制改革是否帮到了小企业,在经济学家中仍争议很大。

column3: a. 艰苦的, 费劲的, 勤劳的
column5: Translating the manuscript by hand was a laborious task that took two years.
column6: 手工翻译这部手稿是一项耗时两年的艰苦工作。

column3: n. 无力, 虚弱, 无效, 阳萎;阳萎, 无能力
column5: The government's impotence in the face of the flooding angered coastal residents.
column6: 政府在洪水面前无能为力,令沿海居民愤怒。

column3: a. 令人不快的, 厌恶的, 不合意的
column5: The disagreeable smell from the chemical plant drifted across the suburb every morning.
column6: 化工厂的难闻气味每天早晨飘过郊区。

column3: a. 麻木的, 无情的, 坚硬的, 硬皮的, 起老茧的;vt. 使生茧, 使变硬
column5: His callous remarks about laid-off workers drew sharp criticism online.
column6: 他对被裁员工的冷酷言论在网上招致尖锐批评。

column3: a. 吸引人的, 非常有趣的;吸收的
column5: The podcast is so absorbing that commuters miss their stops regularly.
column6: 这个播客太吸引人了,通勤者常坐过站。

column3: a. 敏捷的, 灵活的, 机敏的
column5: The agile security team responded to the server breach within minutes.
column6: 反应敏捷的安全团队在几分钟内处置了服务器入侵。

column3: n. 生活资料, 生计, 食物, 支持;营养物, 维持, 支持
column5: The river provided sustenance for fishing communities along its banks for centuries.
column6: 几个世纪以来,这条河养活了两岸的渔村。

column3: n. 幕间, 幕间时间, 插曲, 穿插, 过场;插算; 中间程序
column5: A brief musical interlude separated the two halves of the conference.
column6: 一段简短的音乐表演将会议分为上下两场。

column3: n. 古怪, 古怪行为, 怪癖;偏心度; 偏心距; 偏心率
column5: Visitors loved the professor's eccentricity, from his mismatched socks to his midnight lectures.
column6: 从穿错配的袜子到午夜开讲,来访者都喜欢教授的怪癖。

column3: n. 研磨料;a. 有研磨作用的
column5: His abrasive emails often offended colleagues who had only offered help.
column6: 他生硬刺人的邮件常得罪好心来帮忙的同事。

column3: a. 庞大的, 惊人的, 异常的
column5: The young chess player displayed a prodigious memory for complex opening sequences.
column6: 年轻棋手对复杂开局序列显示出惊人的记忆力。

column3: n. 擅自进入, 非法侵入, 侵害;vi. 侵害, 侵入, 打扰, 冒犯
column5: Hunters who trespass on the private reserve face heavy fines.
column6: 猎人若擅入私人保护区将面临高额罚款。

column3: a. 致病的, 病态的, 疾病的, 可怕的;病的

column6: 纪录片对灾难的病态聚焦让一些观众感到不适。

column3: adv. 宽大地, 大方地, 自由地
column5: The chef drizzled olive oil liberally over the salad before serving.
column6: 厨师在上菜前往沙拉上慷慨地淋了橄榄油。

column3: n. 喳喳声, 唧唧声;v. 吱喳而鸣

column6: 科学家发现,蟋蟀在温暖的夏夜鸣叫得更频繁。

column3: a. 依赖的, 信赖的

column6: 现代办公室高度依赖稳定的网络连接才能运转。
